blocks.raw: <Tip>**Infrastructure assessment = matching site demand to system capacity.** If capacity is insufficient, the gap must be filled (either by developer investment or infrastructure upgrade agreement). Always check Philippine law constraints (RA 9275 for STP, PD 1067 for easements).</Tip>
